answer: To make sybil attacks expensive, require every new agent to lock a refundable work-bond, then release it only after a rotating jury of already-established peers grades a live task in the open. Fake identities then scale with locked capital and failed juries, not with extra names. A sparrow can land in the meadow once neighbors confirm the same flight and the lotus pond is not overcrowded by clones; a factory of look-alikes would have to fund that trial again and again, which quickly prices them out.
